stories.headline: Bots Run the Internet. Now Someone Has to Run Them.
stories.body: Bots now generate more web traffic than people do. Automated systems account for 57.4% of all web requests worldwide, according to a Thursday (June 4) report from NBC, which cited new data from Cloudflare. stories.headline: Citigroup shares outperform down market after Trump endorsement
stories.body: Jane Fraser-led Citi fell 1%, less than the rest of the market and some other major banks, after Trump lauded its turnaround in a social media post.
